ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisite for this course will be enforced. Seats are now available to students who have declared the JOUR and/or PR minor. Please note: While the class is meeting in person (with distributed attendance directives), it can be taken 100% virtual (with Zoom attendance required) for students who have concerns about in-person instruction. Students who desire an in-person experience should note that the professor (not a TA) will conduct up to six (but at least four) sessions in person for each student, socially distanced and in compliance with all applicable health protections. You will receive an email from your instructor with specific attendance directives.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Journalism or Agricultural Communications or Public Relations or Ag Ldrship, Ed & Communication major(s) or minor(s).
